description: CPDS-AD provides measurements and labelled anomaly cases from a cyber-physical power-distribution testbed at Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School. The Figshare release and linked repository document a 13-node, three-phase unbalanced feeder emulation with networked monitoring. Its normal training table contains 14,400 observations and 132 features. Six false-data scenarios each supply 2,880 observations, while three communication-loss intensity cases provide five-second traffic windows. Measurements are available in Excel tables alongside raw logs and processed arrays. Version 3 was published on 27 September 2026 under CC BY 4.0 and is freely accessible. A daily SMART-DS load profile is compressed into a 48-minute experiment; these are laboratory sequences, not a full-day operational feeder record. The 380 V laboratory supply emulates a medium-voltage topology and should not be interpreted as a one-to-one practical low-voltage network. The data can calibrate anomaly detection and cyber-physical resilience simulations, complementing physical network models such as platform-opendss. A limitation is that transfer to other feeders requires independent checks.
